# Neko3SE LAB

> Neko3SE LAB is a personal lab for generative AI content, IT experiments, creative ideas, and browser-based projects.

Canonical site: https://neko3se.com/
Primary language: Japanese. Some content provides English or bilingual interfaces.

Neko3SE LAB practices Generative AI-Driven Development, using generative AI to support planning, design, implementation, review, and improvement while keeping goals, decisions, approvals, and real-device testing as human responsibilities.

Project README.md files are Technical Documentation. Use them for project overviews, features, implementation details, supported environments, known limitations, and experimental findings. Each project README also provides the corresponding live-site URL.

## Site

- [Neko3SE LAB README](https://neko3se.com/README.md): Overview of Neko3SE LAB, its development philosophy, contents, repository structure, and project information.
- [ABOUT Neko3SE](https://neko3se.com/about/): Author profile and background behind Neko3SE LAB and its development activities.
- [Privacy Policy](https://neko3se.com/about/privacy/): Google Analytics and information handling.
- [Terms of Use](https://neko3se.com/about/terms/): Site terms and Apache License 2.0 relationship.

## Development

- [AI駆動型非生産的Web技術研究所。](https://neko3se.com/mudagiken/README.md): Ten browser mini-games exploring deliberately playful and non-productive ideas implemented with generative AI, JavaScript, sound, animation, and multilingual UI.
- [e-Gov 法令検索 Viewer β](https://neko3se.com/egov/README.md): Unofficial browser viewer using the e-Gov Law API, with original genre-based navigation and separate law-name and content search. It does not provide legal advice.
- [PROMPT GENERATOR](https://neko3se.com/promptgen/README.md): Browser-based tool for building reusable structured Markdown prompts with simple and advanced modes, copying and saving, and Base64 Data URL file attachments.
- [PRO IMAGE PROMPT LAB](https://neko3se.com/imageprompt/README.md): Experimental guide to image-generation prompt design covering subject, composition, light, texture, mood, sample prompts, and generated examples.

## Entertainment

- [PIANO EMULATOR](https://neko3se.com/pianoemu/README.md): Two-octave browser piano combining playable keys with text-based note playback, BPM and volume controls, and Japanese and English interfaces.
- [五線譜ドレミclip](https://neko3se.com/gosenfu/README.md): Short browser-based learning clip synchronizing staff notation, solfege labels, and sounding notes using an embedded video.
- [VOICE CHANGER LAB β](https://neko3se.com/voicechanger/README.md): Browser-based voice recording and transformation experiment with waveform visualization, audio metrics, processed-audio playback, and WAV saving.
- [SOUND TUNER LAB β](https://neko3se.com/soundtuner/README.md): Browser-based tuner and audio-analysis experiment for instruments and vocals, including pitch, frequency, tuning, spectrum, waveform, and harmonics visualization.
